method: Every 20 Hz ArmPlan.action7 frame; all 315 convex collision hulls of both robots versus both panels. Complete convex SAT axes (faces and edge-cross-edge), shared across widths; AABB used only for mathematically safe pruning. Positive SAT margin is a conservative Euclidean distance lower bound; minimum of per-hull SAT margins is reported.
gap_definition: Measured 67.999219 mm transverse hand envelope after yaw + 4/6/8/10 mm. 113.546986 mm closing-axis outer span lies along panel length, not the normal.
selected_reason: Tied minimum nominal side margin of 2 mm; selected direct vertical right-arm path is finger-clearance-limited, not fixed-arm-base-limited.
geometric_contact_assumption: Finger closure is blocked at a conservative 66 mm nominal aperture during grasp. Grip, slip, physical tracking and collision contact offsets are not simulated.
censoring: Values of 20 mm are certified lower bounds of at least 20 mm.
table_normalization: CRLF normalized to LF for repository whitespace checks; every parsed CSV cell verified identical.
